prompt:
# The Chopper: paint + material mask view atlas

Scope: image generation only. Write ONLY into `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10022/`. Do not edit any other file, do not run builds.

Inputs (attached):
- `paint_mask_guide.png`: 1536x2048 transparent sheet, three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows
  3-4 hold the same five grey orthographic renders of the exact 3D model: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty.

Task: use your built-in image generation tool to paint the guide sheet. Output ONE PNG with a transparent background
and a 3:4 canvas (1536x2048 or the tool's nearest 3:4 size), the same layout, each object in exactly the same position,
size and outline as its grey guide. Paint the grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.

- Rows 1-2 (PAINT): the unlit base colour of the item on each view: Faithfully repaint the isolated and mechanically rotated original MM9 PCX as an MM6-MM8-style inventory sprite. Treat the MM9 PCX as binding for identity, silhouette, proportions, components, and colors. Preserve the two tall parallel gray blade prongs and their open central slot, uneven chopped tips, compact silver guard, red center accent, blue-and-pale banded grip, and dark pommel. Render one complete vertical two-handed weapon on genuine transparent alpha. Do not merge the prongs or substitute a generic sword. No text, glow, shadow, frame, scenery, or watermark..
- Rows 3-4 (MATERIAL MASK): the same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, no texture, no
  outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside:
  - pure red #FF0000: every metal part (steel, iron, chain mail, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass)
  - pure green #00FF00: every leather part (straps, padding, hide, suede) and fur
  - pure blue #0000FF: every cloth part (tabards, quilting, linings, cords, ribbons) and hair
  - pure yellow #FFFF00: every matte non-metal solid (wood, bone, horn, stone, parchment, paper, wax)
  - pure black #000000: every gemstone, crystal, glass, pearl, enamel or liquid seen through glass
  Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one of these colours; nothing outside the silhouettes.
- `design_reference.png`: the approved HD painting or master of the item, the material and detail reference.
- `icon_x8.png`: the original game icon (magenta is background), the colour reference.

Object: Faithfully repaint the isolated and mechanically rotated original MM9 PCX as an MM6-MM8-style inventory sprite. Treat the MM9 PCX as binding for identity, silhouette, proportions, components, and colors. Preserve the two tall parallel gray blade prongs and their open central slot, uneven chopped tips, compact silver guard, red center accent, blue-and-pale banded grip, and dark pommel. Render one complete vertical two-handed weapon on genuine transparent alpha. Do not merge the prongs or substitute a generic sword. No text, glow, shadow, frame, scenery, or watermark.

- Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference, scaled to each view.
- Keep every gap and opening exactly as in the guide and fully transparent.
- Unlit base colour only: no lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no hot highlights or reflections, no
  glow halo, sparkles or aura outside the silhouette, no ground, no outlines, no text.
- The empty cells (column 3 of row 2 and row 4) stay empty and transparent.

Save the generated image (copy the file the tool produced) to `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10022/paint_mask_raw_v1.png` and write
`generation_paint.json` (prompt, inputs with sha256, original output path, output, size). At most one corrective
regeneration, only if the silhouettes or layout are clearly wrong.

Input order: image 1 design_reference.png appearance reference; image 2 icon_x8.png original color reference; image 3 paint_mask_guide.png EDIT TARGET. Preserve image 3 layout exactly. The small end-on views must stay end-on; horizontal edge views stay horizontal. Do not replace them with broadside swords. Output the full atlas, not a single weapon. Blue grip is wrapped leather (green in material mask); pale grip bands and pommel metal are red in mask, ruby accents black. Genuine transparent background.
CORRECTION: Follow the original gray guide silhouettes with absolute precision, especially the long OPEN TRANSPARENT slit between two blade prongs in row 2 column 2 and row 4 column 2. This slit must remain clear transparent background all the way down to the guard, matching the guide width. Do not fill or narrow the slit. No ragged pixels or extra protrusions outside guide. Flat mask grip silver bands must be red metal, separated by green leather; mask ruby centers black. Preserve exact guide silhouettes in mask as well as painted half.
